entries.description: One list over the documents of several kinds. Its rows are the documents' own - one per written document of each kind it lists - with the columns every document has: Ref, Date, Number, Posted and DeletionMark. A query reads them as DocumentJournal.<Name>, and the journal's list form shows them.
The references of the documents the journal lists, ordered by date, from both or either bound (inclusive). Each reference is the document it is: an invoice comes back an invoice.
entries.parameters: From - the earliest date; To - the latest. Either may be left out.

entries.description: The journal's list form - the default list form when one is named, otherwise one generated from its columns. Opening a row opens its document.
entries.parameters: Name - a form of the journal, or empty for the default; Owner - the form that owns it; Key - the form's window key.
